experiment: P5 H4 joint-schedule label dataset v1
purpose: materialize every H<=4 schedule and its two frozen continuation rewards so a later source-disjoint schedule ranker can be trained without changing the passed P5 oracle identity

row_identity.unit: one nonoverlapping horizon of one to four complete four-window blocks
row_identity.past: the P5 oracle's own previously selected horizons
stored_targets: two signed terminal edit-error rewards versus the all-center schedule for every candidate
minimum of those rewards as robust value
P5 eligible winner after the frozen tie-break
row_identity.folds: five deterministic source-video-disjoint folds using SHA256('robust-oof-v1\0'+source) modulo 5
row_identity.label_visibility: targets read reference, future continuations, and true endpoint and are nondeployable

integrity_gates: 48229 horizons with the exact P5 horizon-size distribution
chosen schedules reproduce 857 changed horizons, 1097 noncenter bonuses, and summed robust horizon reward 877
uniform reproduces 2325 errors and chosen schedules reproduce 1447 errors
per-sample rows reproduce the frozen P5 per-sample errors and counts

next_experiment_not_part_of_this_dataset.action_deadline: features must be available at the first block start of each horizon; no within-horizon future frames
next_experiment_not_part_of_this_dataset.warning: predictor representation, loss, gates, and seeds require a separate preregistration after this dataset passes integrity

forbidden: calibration, dev, test, held-out, or closed-loop outcomes
changing the P5 candidate schedules, reward, continuations, eligibility, or tie-break
treating oracle-state OOF as deployable closed-loop evidence
